flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for a 2OIC screen to view the Letter of Advice list and exclusion reasons.
note: Synonyms tried across the six repos (UI and API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, court batch, 2OIC, 2nd OIC, 1st OIC, route to OIC, re-route, approve list, reject list, excluded reason, exclusion reason, remove/delete defendant. Only these were found: labels in translation.json (letter_of_advice :122, letter_of_advice_list :123, court_batch_no :125, not used by any component), path constant COURT_BATCH_DURATION (Fsystemadmin.d.ts:26) with no backend resource, type 'warrantofarrest' (Fapi.d.ts:260) and paths /v1/warrantofarrest, /v1/courtmention, /v1/courttrial, /v1/courtcase in api-authorization.properties:23 which is only an authorization list with no controller in any Java repo. The only backend court endpoint is CasIntegrationController (CAS-to-OCMS, not a Letter of Advice feature) and it is not credited: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Story status is blank in the data (requirement not given); traced normally. No maintenance ticket matches (grep advice / warrant / court batch / 2OIC = 0 relevant).
recommendation: Evidence 0%. Do not claim a 2OIC review screen for the Letter of Advice list.

steps.step: The 2OIC opens the list routed from the 1st OIC
steps.detail: Only the 'List Letter of Advice' label (translation.json:123) with no component; there is no UI route or 2OIC role authorization (grep 2OIC = 0). Path-based staff authorization in api-authorization.properties has no LOA mapping.

steps.step: The 2OIC views the included and excluded notices and defendants
steps.detail: No endpoint or query returns an LOA list; /v1/warrantofarrest exists only in the authorization list (api-authorization.properties:23) with no controller.

steps.step: The 2OIC sees the reasons for excluded notices
steps.detail: There is no exclusion-reason field; the 'OIC Review' accordion (DecissionDetails.tsx:337) belongs to notice/appeal decisions, not LOA exclusion reasons.
